subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: After the three event-delivery defects and merge conflicts are resolved, should CodexBar ship this supported local-command hook contract?
rationale: The implementation is opt-in and substantially hardened, but it intentionally adds persistent configuration that executes local commands and exposes stable event payload semantics, which requires repository-owner acceptance.

options.title: Ship after focused repairs
options.body: Fix the three delivery defects, rebase cleanly, preserve the hardened execution boundary, and land the feature with regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce the first release to the best-proven events or CLI surface, deferring less reliable transition sources until they have equivalent coverage.

options.title: Pause external execution
options.body: Defer the PR if CodexBar should remain observability-only without a supported local command-execution surface.

recommendation.title: Ship after focused repairs
recommendation.body: Fix the three delivery defects, rebase cleanly, preserve the hardened execution boundary, and land the feature with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the recent hardening and integration commits and are the clearest owner of the product and security-boundary decision.
